<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Condensed:wght@700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* === Fire Truck Template Overrides === */

  /* Title — IBM Plex Sans Condensed Bold */
  .main-product .product__title {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    font-size: clamp(32px, 3.5vw, 45px) !important;
    line-height: 0.95 !important;
    color: #0b0c0e !important;
  }

  /* Breadcrumbs — last crumb red + semibold */
  .breadcrumbs .breadcrumbs__list .breadcrumbs__item:last-child .breadcrumbs__link,
  .breadcrumbs .breadcrumbs__list .breadcrumbs__item:last-child span.breadcrumbs__link {
    color: #e11d2a !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
  }

  /* Gallery — main image border */
  .main-product #GalleryViewer-section--main .product__media-item .global-media-settings {
    border: 1px solid #e1dccd !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
  }

  /* Gallery — thumbnail inactive border */
  .main-product .thumbnail-list__item .thumbnail {
    border: 1.5px solid #e1dccd !important;
    border-radius: 8px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
  }

  /* Gallery — active thumbnail: red border + pink bg */
  .main-product .thumbnail-list__item .thumbnail[aria-current="true"] {
    border: 2px solid #e11d2a !important;
    background-color: #ffe3e5 !important;
  }

  /* Gallery — nav arrows circular */
  .main-product .slider-buttons .slider-button,
  .main-product #GalleryViewer-section--main ~ .slider-buttons .slider-button {
    width: 42px !important;
    height: 42px !important;
    border-radius: 999px !important;
    border: 1px solid #e1dccd !important;
    background: #fff !important;
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
  }

  /* Qty + Add to Cart — side by side row */
  .main-product .product-buy-buttons .product-form__buttons {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: row !important;
    align-items: stretch !important;
    gap: 12px !important;
    flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  }

  /* Qty label — hide (label is in figma as plain text above, not inside qty widget) */
  .main-product .product-form__quantity .quantity__label {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Quantity widget — navy pill with drop shadow */
  .main-product .quantity {
    border: 2px solid #001429 !important;
    border-radius: 16px !important;
    box-shadow: -2px 4px 0px #001429 !important;
    flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  }

  /* Add to Cart button — red pill with navy border + drop shadow + arrow */
  .main-product .product-form__submit {
    border-radius: 16px !important;
    border: 2px solid #001429 !important;
    box-shadow: -2px 4px 0px #001429 !important;
    background: #e11d2a !important;
    color: #fff !important;
    flex: 1 !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    gap: 8px !important;
  }
  .main-product .product-form__submit .ft-arrow {
    font-size: 1.1em;
    line-height: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* Price — sale price color */
  .main-product .price__sale .price-item--sale {
    color: #df1d37 !important;
  }

  /* === Color Swatch Cards === */
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch {
    border: none !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
  }
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch .swatch-input__label,
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill .swatch-input__label {
    width: 72px !important;
    height: 72px !important;
    border-radius: 8px !important;
    border: 1.5px solid #e1dccd !important;
    background: #fff !important;
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    gap: 4px !important;
    padding: 8px 0 !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
    text-indent: 0 !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
  }
  /* Color circle */
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch .swatch,
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill .swatch {
    width: 36px !important;
    height: 36px !important;
    border-radius: 50% !important;
    flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  }
  /* Variant name via CSS attr(title) */
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch .swatch-input__label::after,
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill .swatch-input__label::after {
    content: attr(title) !important;
    font-size: 9px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.54px !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    color: #6b7280 !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    line-height: 1.2 !important;
  }
  /* Active swatch — red border */
  .main-product .swatch-input__input:checked + .swatch-input__label {
    border: 2px solid #e11d2a !important;
  }
  /* Pill buttons (non-swatch fallback) */
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill .swatch-input__label,
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill label.swatch-input__label {
    width: 72px !important;
    height: 72px !important;
    border-radius: 8px !important;
    border: 1.5px solid #e1dccd !important;
    font-size: 9px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.54px !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    color: #6b7280 !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    padding: 4px !important;
  }
  .main-product .swatch-input__input:checked + label.swatch-input__label {
    border: 2px solid #e11d2a !important;
    color: #0b0c0e !important;
  }
  /* Option legend label */
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch legend,
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill legend {
    font-size: 11px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    letter-spacing: 1.1px !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    color: #0b0c0e !important;
  }

  /* === Fix: remove theme's default outline on active swatch (causes double border) === */
  .main-product .swatch-input__input:checked + .swatch-input__label {
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border: 2px solid #e11d2a !important;
  }
  .main-product .swatch-input__label:focus,
  .main-product .swatch-input__label:focus-visible {
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

  /* === Color label: "COLOR" bold + "• SelectedValue" gray === */
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch legend,
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill legend {
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    gap: 0 !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    letter-spacing: 1.1px !important;
    text-transform: uppercase !important;
    color: #0b0c0e !important;
    margin-bottom: 8px !important;
  }
  /* Hide the colon the theme adds via CSS */
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch legend::after,
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill legend::after {
    content: none !important;
  }
  /* Selected value span — gray + dot prefix */
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch legend span[data-selected-swatch-value],
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill legend span[data-selected-value] {
    color: #6b7280 !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0 !important;
  }
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch legend span[data-selected-swatch-value]::before,
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill legend span[data-selected-value]::before {
    content: ' \2022  ' !important;
    color: #6b7280 !important;
  }

  /* === Price styling: 26px semibold, red on sale, dark when regular === */
  .main-product .price--large .price__regular .price-item--regular,
  .main-product .price .price__regular .price-item--regular {
    font-size: 26px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    color: #0b0c0e !important;
  }
  .main-product .price--large .price__sale .price-item--sale,
  .main-product .price .price__sale .price-item--sale {
    font-size: 26px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    color: #df1d37 !important;
  }
  .main-product .price .price__sale .price-item--regular {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    color: #6b7280 !important;
    text-decoration: line-through !important;
  }

  /* === Shipping text: 12px normal #1d1d1f === */
  .main-product .product__policies,
  .main-product [id^="price-"] ~ p,
  .main-product .price__shipping {
    font-size: 12px !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
    color: #1d1d1f !important;
  }
  .main-product .price__shipping a,
  .main-product .price__shipping .link {
    color: #1d1d1f !important;
    text-decoration: underline !important;
  }

  /* === Qty + CTA: stack vertically on mobile === */
  @media (max-width: 749px) {
    .main-product .product-buy-buttons .product-form__buttons {
      flex-direction: column !important;
      align-items: stretch !important;
    }
    .main-product .product-form__quantity {
      width: 100% !important;
    }
    .main-product .quantity {
      width: 100% !important;
    }
    .main-product .product-form__submit {
      width: 100% !important;
    }
  }


  /* === Product info column — 22px gap between all blocks (Figma) === */
  .main-product .product__info-container {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    gap: 22px !important;
  }
  /* Reset any existing block-level margins so gap is the single source of truth */
  .main-product .product__info-container > * {
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    margin-bottom: 0 !important;
  }

  /* Variant picker: 10px between legend and swatch row (Figma) */
  .main-product .product-form__input--swatch,
  .main-product .product-form__input--pill {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    gap: 10px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
  }

  /* Buy buttons: 9px between quantity label and qty+CTA row (Figma) */
  .main-product .product-form__input.product-form__quantity {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    gap: 9px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
  }

  /* Price block: 12px between price row and shipping (Figma) */
  .main-product .price__container {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    gap: 12px !important;
  }

</style>

<script>
(function() {
  function patchATC() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.product-form__submit').forEach(function(btn) {
      if (btn.querySelector('.ft-arrow')) return;
      var span = btn.querySelector('span:not(.visually-hidden)');
      if (span) {
        var arrow = document.createElement('span');
        arrow.className = 'ft-arrow';
        arrow.textContent = '→';
        btn.appendChild(arrow);
      }
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', patchATC);
  document.addEventListener('variant:change', patchATC);

  // Fix color label: strip the ": " the theme JS prepends to swatch value span
  function fixSwatchLabel() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-selected-swatch-value]').forEach(function(span) {
      if (span.textContent.startsWith(': ')) {
        span.textContent = span.textContent.slice(2);
      }
    });
  }
  // Run on load and on variant change
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixSwatchLabel);
  document.addEventListener('variant:change', fixSwatchLabel);
  // Also observe for JS-driven updates
  var swatchObserver = new MutationObserver(fixSwatchLabel);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-selected-swatch-value]').forEach(function(el) {
    swatchObserver.observe(el, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
  });
})();
</script>
